nindian-geography-6-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the location of India's neighbours?
o: China lies to the north of India.
Bhutan lies to the east of India.
Myanmar lies to the east of India.
Afghanistan lies to the north-west of India.
nindian-geography-6-2.x: Bhutan lies to the north-east of India, between Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh, not to the east. The other three are correct.

n55b70fd2052.s:
Consider the following statements about the Tropic of Cancer:
1. It roughly divides India into two halves.
2. It passes through northern Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n55b70fd2052.x: The Tropic of Cancer roughly halves India. Present Andhra Pradesh (12°41′ N - 19°07′ N) lies wholly south of it, so it does not pass through AP.

n4f2daf8f6be.s: Which of the following neighbours of India is NOT a member of SAARC?
n4f2daf8f6be.x: All of India's neighbours except China are SAARC members.

n82ee49b7fbb.s: India's land border of 15,106.7 km extends across:
n82ee49b7fbb.x: India's 15,106.7 km land border extends across 16 States and 2 Union Territories.

nindian-geography-5-2.s: Which of the following boundary lines is wrongly matched?
nindian-geography-5-2.x: The Line of Control of 1972 separates India and Pakistan, not India and China.

nd3a35c070ef.s: The rise in India's coastline length from 7,516.6 km to 11,098.81 km is mainly due to:
o: Physical growth of deltas and coastal land
Finer GIS tracing of creeks and inlets at a 1:250,000 scale
nd3a35c070ef.x: The roughly 47.7% rise came from improved measurement, mainly finer GIS tracing of creeks and inlets at 1:250,000 scale, not a physical increase in coastline.

n9a1ad295853.s: Which of the following Union Territories is NOT a coastal Union Territory?
n9a1ad295853.x: Chandigarh is landlocked. The coastal UTs are Andaman and Nicobar, Lakshadweep, Puducherry and Daman and Diu.

nec2c56831c5.s: As per the 2023–24 remeasurement, Andhra Pradesh's coastline (about 1,053.07 km) ranks:
o: Third, after Gujarat and Tamil Nadu
Fourth, after Gujarat, Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra
nec2c56831c5.x: The 2023–24 remeasurement puts AP's coastline at about 1,053.07 km, third-longest after Gujarat and Tamil Nadu.

nworld-geography-20-2.s:
Consider the following statements about the Strait of Hormuz:
1. It lies between Iran and Oman.
2. It connects the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea.
3. About 10% of global oil trade passes through it.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nworld-geography-20-2.x: About 20%, not 10%, of global oil trade passes through Hormuz, which lies between Iran and Oman and links the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman.

nap-geography-2-6.s: Which of the following neighbours of Rayalaseema is correctly matched with its direction?
nap-geography-2-6.x: Rayalaseema has Tamil Nadu to the south, Karnataka to the west and Telangana to the north.

n70369884f30.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nanga Parbat – eastern end of the Himalaya
Kailash – western end of the Himalaya
Dhaulagiri – eastern end of the Himalaya
Namcha Barwa – eastern end of the Himalaya, in Tibet
n70369884f30.x: Namcha Barwa marks the eastern end of the Assam Himalaya and lies in Tibet, China; Nanga Parbat marks the western end.

n92a34a204a4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n92a34a204a4.x: Nathu La in Sikkim links Gangtok with Tibet through the Chumbi Valley. Zoji La is the Srinagar–Leh pass, Tawang–Lhasa is Bomdi La's route and Jammu–Srinagar is Banihal's.

ne7c3093a043.s:
Arrange the following Himalayan ranges from north to south:
A. Himachal
B. Karakoram
C. Shiwalik
D. Himadri
ne7c3093a043.x: From north to south: Karakoram, Himadri, Himachal and Shiwalik (B, D, A, C).

n3e70aaccb07.s: Near Namcha Barwa, the Himalaya takes a sharp knee-bend at the:
n3e70aaccb07.x: The Himalaya bends at the Dihang gorge near Namcha Barwa and turns south as the Purvanchal hills.

n5667ddb0dbb.s: Godwin Austen (K2), the world's second-highest peak (8,611 m), belongs to which range?
n5667ddb0dbb.x: K2 (8,611 m) belongs to the Karakoram and lies in territory under Pakistan-China control.

nindian-geography-13-1.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
nindian-geography-13-1.x: Zoji La lies on the Srinagar–Leh route; Baralacha La is the one on the Manali–Leh route.

nindian-geography-13-2.s: Which of the following passes is wrongly matched?
nindian-geography-13-2.x: Niti Pass links Uttarakhand with Tibet, not Myanmar.

ne4795226f82.s: The mainland of India extends approximately between:
ne4795226f82.x: India's mainland extends from 8°4′ N to 37°6′ N latitude and 68°7′ E to 97°25′ E longitude.

n36f1b60d38b.x: India has 28 States and 8 Union Territories.

n59c150fe8c2.s: Besides the NCT of Delhi, Uttar Pradesh shares borders with how many States?
n59c150fe8c2.x: Uttar Pradesh borders eight States and the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

n8403c832572.s: Which is the longest glacier in India?
n8403c832572.x: Siachen Glacier, in the Karakoram of Ladakh, is the longest glacier in India.

nindian-geography-12-2.s: Which of the following peaks is wrongly matched with its location?
nindian-geography-12-2.x: Saramati is in Nagaland; the Garo Hills peak is Nokrek.

n0e498939350.shape: one-liner (NOT not possible: only three true pairs given)
n0e498939350.s: The Kashmir, Kangra and Kullu valleys lie in which Himalayan range?
n0e498939350.x: Kashmir, Kangra and Kullu valleys lie in the Himachal or Lesser Himalaya, not the Shiwalik.

n6016ec73ce1.s: Which plain was formed mainly by the tributaries of the Indus and is marked by doabs?
n6016ec73ce1.x: The Punjab Plain was formed by Indus tributaries and contains doabs. The Brahmaputra Plain is the Assam valley; the Kosi Plain is an alluvial fan in north Bihar.

n5f5662e6430.s: The Deccan Plateau, lying south of the Narmada, is largely made up of:
n5f5662e6430.x: The Deccan Plateau lies south of the Narmada and is largely composed of basaltic rocks.

ndb495d71dc2.s: Weathering of the Deccan Trap produces which soil, well suited to cotton?
ndb495d71dc2.x: Deccan Trap weathering yields regur or black soil, particularly suitable for cotton.

nindian-geography-14-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the ranges of central and north-western India?
o: The Aravalli extends from Rajasthan into Haryana, reaching Delhi.
The Narmada and Tapti flank the Satpura Range.
The Vindhya and Satpura ranges converge at Yercaud.
The Vindhya Range lies in Central India.
nindian-geography-14-2.x: The Vindhya and Satpura ranges meet near Amarkantak, not Yercaud, which is in the Shevaroy Hills.

nindian-geography-40-4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Malwa Plateau?
o: It lies between the Aravalli and Vindhya ranges.
It lies to the east of Bundelkhand.
The Aravalli range lies to its north.
The Vindhya range lies to its south.
nindian-geography-40-4.x: Malwa lies west of Bundelkhand; Bundelkhand is on its east.

nindian-geography-12-12.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
nindian-geography-12-12.x: Nokrek is in Meghalaya, not Uttarakhand.

n4e41526396f.s: Anamudi peak (2,695 m) is located in which State?
n4e41526396f.x: Anamudi is in Kerala and rises to 2,695 metres.

n138af44f147.s: Which of the following peaks is NOT correctly matched with its State?
n138af44f147.x: Arma Konda is in Andhra Pradesh, not Odisha.

n006154febc1.s: Which of the following peaks is correctly matched with its State?
n006154febc1.x: Mahendragiri (about 1,500 m) is in Odisha. Parasnath is in Jharkhand, Dhupgarh in Madhya Pradesh and Kalsubai in Maharashtra.

n13acd25d6ef.s: Thalghat in the Western Ghats links Mumbai with:
n13acd25d6ef.x: Thalghat links Mumbai and Nashik, while Bhorghat links Mumbai and Pune.

nindian-geography-28-23.s: The Maikal Range forms the eastern part of which system?
nindian-geography-28-23.x: The Maikal Range forms the eastern end of the Satpura system near Amarkantak.

nf6577e78942.s: In 2024, Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, was renamed:
nf6577e78942.x: Port Blair was renamed Sri Vijaya Puram in 2024.

ngeneral-geography-5-105.shape: one-liner (two-pair match too thin for four options)
ngeneral-geography-5-105.s: Which of the following is India's only active volcano?
ngeneral-geography-5-105.x: Barren Island is India's only active volcano; Narcondam is dormant.

n41d19abe36a.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nanga Parbat – western end of the Himadri
n41d19abe36a.x: Nanga Parbat (about 8,126 m) lies at the western end of the Himadri. Kamet is in Uttarakhand, Zemu in Sikkim and Gangotri in Uttarakhand.

nindian-geography-44-4.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
nindian-geography-44-4.x: The Lahaul Valley is in Himachal Pradesh, not Assam.

nindian-geography-32-8.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched with its location?
nindian-geography-32-8.x: Diu lies on the Kathiawar coast near the Gulf of Khambhat, not on the Gulf of Kutch.

n300d31f4138.s: Tso Moriri, a brackish lake with Ramsar-site status, is located in:
n300d31f4138.x: Tso Moriri is a brackish lake in Ladakh and a Ramsar site.

nindian-geography-2-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the tributaries of the Indus?
o: The Chenab is the largest tributary of the Indus.
The Kishanganga is called the Neelum in Pakistan.
The Sutlej is a tributary of the Indus.
The Kishanganga is a tributary of the Sutlej.
nindian-geography-2-2.x: The Kishanganga (Neelum) is a tributary of the Jhelum, not the Sutlej.

ne16c00963a2.s:
Arrange the following tributaries of the Ganga in the order of their confluence below Prayagraj (west to east):
A. Gandak
B. Son
C. Kosi
D. Ghaghara
ne16c00963a2.x: Below Prayagraj the order is Ghaghara, Son, Gandak and Kosi (D, B, A, C).

nindian-geography-31-15.s: Which of the following projects is INCORRECTLY matched with its river?
nindian-geography-31-15.x: Jayakwadi is on the Godavari, not the Cauvery.

nindian-geography-1-2.s:
Consider the following statements about the Ganga:
1. It enters the plains at Haridwar.
2. It flows through Farakka in West Bengal before entering Bangladesh.
3. In Bangladesh it is known as the Jamuna.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nindian-geography-1-2.x: In Bangladesh the Ganga is the Padma; the Jamuna there is the Brahmaputra.

n291a0074593.s: The Brahmaputra is called the 'sorrow of Assam' mainly because of its:
n291a0074593.x: The Brahmaputra is called the 'sorrow of Assam' because of the floods it causes.

n48da8f87616.s: On entering the plains, Himalayan rivers typically develop:
o: Meanders, shifting channels, ox-bow lakes and floodplains
n48da8f87616.x: The gentle gradient of the plains makes Himalayan rivers meander, shift channels and form ox-bow lakes and floodplains.

n20e58acc98f.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n20e58acc98f.x: Loktak Lake in Manipur is a freshwater lake noted for its floating phumdis. Pangong Tso and Tso Moriri are in Ladakh; Roopkund is in Uttarakhand.

naf2432f4cd4.s: Which of the following lakes is NOT correctly matched?
naf2432f4cd4.x: Wular is in Jammu and Kashmir and is India's largest freshwater lake, not a brackish lake of Ladakh.

nindian-geography-31-9.s: Which of the following projects is INCORRECTLY matched with its river?
nindian-geography-31-9.x: Hirakud is on the Mahanadi, not the Godavari.

nindian-geography-1-8.s:
Consider the following statements about the Narmada:
1. It flows west through a rift valley into the Bay of Bengal.
2. It originates at Amarkantak in the Maikal Range.
3. Its valley lies between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nindian-geography-1-8.x: The Narmada flows west through its rift valley into the Arabian Sea, not the Bay of Bengal.

nindian-geography-1-13.s: Which of the following city–river pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-1-13.x: Ahmedabad is on the Sabarmati. Kota is on the Chambal, Gorakhpur on the Rapti and Pandharpur on the Chandrabhaga.

nap-geography-2-3.s:
Consider the following statements about the Tammileru:
1. It drains into Kolleru Lake.
2. It forms the boundary between Krishna and East Godavari districts.
3. A dam has been built on it.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nap-geography-2-3.x: The Tammileru separates Krishna and West Godavari districts, not East Godavari.

n3d6f4c4cbde.s: The Godavari is popularly known as:
n3d6f4c4cbde.x: The Godavari is known as Dakshin Ganga or Dakshina Ganga.

n1577d6a8ad0.s: The Sabari joins the Godavari near:
n1577d6a8ad0.x: The Sabari joins the Godavari near Kunavaram in Andhra Pradesh. The Pranhita joins near Kaleshwaram, and Sangameswaram is a Krishna–Tungabhadra confluence.

n6fe7959822a.s: Which of the following is a right-bank tributary of the Krishna?
n6fe7959822a.x: Ghataprabha is a right-bank tributary of the Krishna. Bhavani joins the Kaveri, Sheonath the Mahanadi, and Musi is a left-bank Krishna tributary.

n97e4b24e5e5.s: The Krishna meets the Tungabhadra at:
n97e4b24e5e5.x: The Krishna meets the Tungabhadra at Sangameswaram (Nandyal). Hamsaladeevi is the Krishna's sea outlet and Antarvedi the Godavari's.

nap-geography-3-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Krishna River?
o: It originates at Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra.
It joins the Tungabhadra at Sangam in Kurnool district.
It splits into two branches at Puligadda, 64 km above Vijayawada.
It enters the Bay of Bengal at Hamsaladeevi.
nap-geography-3-2.x: The Krishna splits at Puligadda, 64 km below Vijayawada, not above it.

nindian-geography-2-4.s: Which of the following river–tributary pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-2-4.x: The Spiti joins the Sutlej. The Tawa joins the Narmada, the Bhavani the Cauvery and the Kharkai the Subarnarekha.

nindian-geography-37-3.s: Which of the following lakes is wrongly matched with its location?
nindian-geography-37-3.x: Pulicat lies on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border, not in Odisha; Chilika is the Odisha lake.

nindian-geography-3-2.s: Which of the following waterfalls is wrongly matched with its location?
nindian-geography-3-2.x: Amritdhara is in Chhattisgarh; Latehar in Jharkhand has Lodh Falls.

n2df4cdead48.s: Which of the following inter-State water disputes is NOT correctly matched?
o: Vamsadhara – AP and Odisha; award in 2017
Mahadayi – Goa, Karnataka and Maharashtra; award in 2018
n2df4cdead48.x: The Cauvery Tribunal gave its final order in 2007; the Supreme Court decision came in 2018.

nindian-geography-37-20.s: Which of the following lake–State pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-geography-37-20.x: Loktak is in Manipur, Lonar in Maharashtra and Roopkund in Uttarakhand.

n0843b206ee3.s: Lonar, a saline-alkaline lake formed in a meteorite-impact crater, is located in:
n0843b206ee3.x: Lonar Lake in Maharashtra lies in a meteorite-impact crater.

o: Local winds confined to coastal districts
Primary planetary winds blowing permanently in one direction
Upper-air winds that never reach the surface
Seasonal secondary winds that reverse direction with the season
n7e3d1380ebe.x: Monsoons are seasonal or periodic secondary winds whose direction reverses with the season; they are not primary planetary winds.

nebb7fe99110.s: The Tamil Nadu coast stays relatively dry during the south-west monsoon mainly because:
o: It lies on the leeward side and the winds blow parallel to the coast
The monsoon withdraws early from the coast
Bay of Bengal winds lose moisture over the Eastern Ghats
nebb7fe99110.x: The Tamil Nadu coast is in a rain-shadow position during the south-west monsoon, and the winds largely blow parallel to it.

n2c77b0b8228.s: Agumbe and Hulikal on the Western Ghats receive very heavy rainfall from the:
o: Arabian Sea branch of the south-west monsoon
Bay of Bengal branch of the south-west monsoon
n2c77b0b8228.x: The Arabian Sea branch strikes the Western Ghats first, giving very heavy rain at Agumbe and Hulikal.

ndisaster-management-16-2.s:
Consider the following statements about hailstorms in India:
1. They occur mainly in the post-monsoon months of October to December.
2. They are rare during the monsoon season.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ndisaster-management-16-2.x: Hailstorms in India occur mainly in the pre-monsoon season (March–May) and in winter, not October–December, and are rare during the monsoon.

n4a705d9d8e8.s: Which of the following Koeppen climate types is correctly matched with its region?
n4a705d9d8e8.x: BWhw (hot desert) is extreme western Rajasthan. As is the Coromandel coast, Cwg the Ganga plain and Amw the west coast south of Goa.

ndisaster-management-16-4.shape: one-liner (four-way regional grid reduced to its clearest fact)
ndisaster-management-16-4.s: In Maharashtra, which regions are especially vulnerable to hailstorms?
ndisaster-management-16-4.x: Hailstorm-prone areas of Maharashtra are especially Vidarbha and Marathwada.

nindian-geography-16-3.s: Which of the following does NOT receive winter rainfall from Western Disturbances?
nindian-geography-16-3.x: The Tamil Nadu coast gets winter rain from the north-east monsoon, not Western Disturbances.

ndisaster-management-8-11.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Drought-prone areas – less than 750 mm rainfall
Chronically drought-prone areas – about 35% of India's area
Chronically drought-prone areas – less than 750 mm rainfall
Drought-prone areas – about 33% of India's area
ndisaster-management-8-11.x: Chronically drought-prone areas get under 750 mm of rain and cover about 33% of India; drought-prone areas get 750–1125 mm and cover about 35%.

ndisaster-management-8-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about drought and famine management in India?
o: The Arthashastra devoted a section to measures against famines.
The Drought Prone Areas Programme was a holistic drought-management programme.
The Disaster Management Act was enacted in 2006.
The Green Revolution of the late 1960s reduced the need for famine-relief work.
ndisaster-management-8-2.x: The Disaster Management Act was enacted in 2005, not 2006.

n63be6c87a40.s: Of Andhra Pradesh's average annual rainfall of about 966 mm, the South-west Monsoon contributes about:
n63be6c87a40.x: About two-thirds of AP's 966 mm comes from the South-west Monsoon and one-third from the North-east Monsoon.

ne980b921e12.s: Sandalwood is chiefly associated with which forest type?
o: Tropical evergreen forests of the Western Ghats
Moist deciduous forests of the Terai
Dry deciduous forests of South India
ne980b921e12.x: Sandalwood is associated with the dry deciduous forests of South India.

necf6215cbed.s: A seed-raised, long-rotation timber crop kept as an uneven-aged forest without complete clearance is obtained through:
necf6215cbed.x: High forest gives a seed-raised, long-rotation timber crop, and the selection system keeps the forest uneven-aged by removing mature trees singly or in groups.

nindian-geography-23-2.s: Which forest type is wrongly matched with its location?
o: Evergreen forests – Andaman and Nicobar Islands
nindian-geography-23-2.x: Thorn forests grow in western, not eastern, Andhra Pradesh.

nindian-geography-33-15.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Wild Ass Sanctuary – Little Rann of Kutch
nindian-geography-33-15.x: The Wild Ass Sanctuary is in the Little Rann of Kutch. Narayan Sarovar is in Kutch, Harike at the Beas–Sutlej confluence, and Keoladeo is known for birds.

nenvironment-9-5.s: The Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary, a mangrove area on Chorao Island, is in:
nenvironment-9-5.x: The Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary on Chorao Island, a mangrove area on the Mandovi, is in Goa.

n6e360502ad7.s: In the Himalaya, sub-tropical chir pine forests occur at about:
n6e360502ad7.x: Chir pine occurs around 1,000–1,800 m; moist temperate forests are at 1,500–3,000 m and alpine meadows at 2,900–6,000 m.

nindian-geography-49-10.s: Which of the following mangrove sites is INCORRECTLY matched with its State?
nindian-geography-49-10.x: Coondapur is in Karnataka, not Maharashtra.

nenvironment-33-6.s: Which of the following mangrove sites is INCORRECTLY matched with its State?
nenvironment-33-6.x: The Gulf of Kachchh mangroves are in Gujarat; Achra-Ratnagiri is the Maharashtra site.

n5e03ff581fb.s: ISFR 2023 puts Andhra Pradesh's forest cover at about 30,085 sq km. The often-quoted 38,436.58 sq km is wrong as 'forest cover' because it also adds:
o: The mangrove area a second time
n5e03ff581fb.x: 38,436.58 sq km = 30,084.96 sq km forest cover + 8,351.62 sq km scrub; scrub (canopy below 10%) is not forest cover in ISFR.

n86986a2a64b.s: Betla National Park forms the core of which tiger reserve?
n86986a2a64b.x: Palamau in Jharkhand, one of the original nine Project Tiger reserves, has Betla National Park as its core.

nenvironment-12-2.s: Which tiger reserve is wrongly matched with its State(s)?
nenvironment-12-2.x: Pench Tiger Reserve spans Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra, not Telangana.

nenvironment-12-4.s:
Assertion (A): Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam Tiger Reserve lies in both Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
Reason (R): Amrabad Tiger Reserve is located in Telangana.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nenvironment-12-4.x: Amrabad Tiger Reserve is in Telangana, so R is true. After bifurcation, the Telangana part of the reserve became Amrabad, so Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam now lies in Andhra Pradesh alone and A is false (original WHY contradicted this key).

n9a306abb585.s: Conservation reserves and community reserves were introduced by the:
n9a306abb585.x: Conservation and community reserves were added by the 2002 amendment to the Wildlife Protection Act; the Indian Forest Act, 1927 governs reserved, protected and village forests.

nindian-geography-33-5.s: Which wildlife sanctuary is wrongly matched with its location?
o: National Chambal – Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh
nindian-geography-33-5.x: Indravati is in Chhattisgarh, not Madhya Pradesh.

nindian-geography-18-2.s: Which national park is wrongly matched with its location?
o: Silent Valley – Palakkad and Malappuram, Kerala
nindian-geography-18-2.x: Nokrek National Park is in the Garo Hills, not the Khasi Hills.

nenvironment-14-2.s: The Wildlife Protection Act, India's first comprehensive wildlife law, received Presidential assent on:
nenvironment-14-2.x: The Wildlife Protection Act received Presidential assent on 9 September 1972.

nindian-geography-18-4.s: Which of the following national parks is correctly matched with its location?
nindian-geography-18-4.x: Hemis is in Ladakh. Kaziranga is in Assam, Gir in Gujarat and Betla in Jharkhand.

nenvironment-15-2.s: Which national park is wrongly matched with its State?
nenvironment-15-2.x: Guindy National Park is in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, not Kerala.

nworld-geography-30-2.s: Which of the following is wrongly matched?
o: Kruger National Park – the Big Five
Great Barrier Reef – largest coral reef system
Okavango Delta – inland delta with high wildlife density
nworld-geography-30-2.x: Etosha in Namibia is known for its salt pan; mountain gorillas live in Virunga.

nap-geography-14-7.shape: one-liner (three-pair match too thin for a correct/incorrect pair set)
nap-geography-14-7.s: Papikonda National Park is located near:
nap-geography-14-7.x: Papikonda NP is near Rajamahendravaram; Sri Venkateswara NP is at Tirupati and Rajiv Gandhi NP at Rameswaram.

n81bcfc065c0.s: Which Ramsar site is correctly matched with its State?
n81bcfc065c0.x: Kopra Reservoir is in Chhattisgarh. Surha Tal and Shekha Jheel are in Uttar Pradesh; Khichan and Menar are in Rajasthan.

n0c95fece71e.s: Which bird sanctuary is correctly matched with its State?
n0c95fece71e.x: Ranganathittu is on Kaveri islets in Mandya, Karnataka. Pitti is in Lakshadweep, Sultanpur in Haryana and Nal Sarovar in Gujarat.

nindian-geography-42-6.s: Which bird sanctuary is wrongly matched with its State?
nindian-geography-42-6.x: Bharatpur (Keoladeo) is in Rajasthan, not Haryana.

nenvironment-18-2.s: Which bird sanctuary is wrongly matched with its district?
o: Okhla – Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
nenvironment-18-2.x: Parvati Arga is in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh; the Sahibganj (Jharkhand) sanctuary is Udhwa.

n075f4eb1041.shape: one-liner (compound chronology reduced to its clearest dated fact)
n075f4eb1041.s: India's first Ramsar site, designated in 1981, is:
n075f4eb1041.x: Chilika became India's first Ramsar site in 1981; Corbett was the first Tiger Reserve (1973) and Glaw Lake the newest Ramsar site (2026).

nindian-geography-19-13.s: Which of the following region–soil pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Thar Desert of western Rajasthan – Arid soil
Himalayan and hilly regions – Mountain or forest soil
Coastal and deltaic plains – Alluvial soil
nindian-geography-19-13.x: The Deccan lava plateau has black soil, not alluvial soil.

nindian-geography-19-2.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Khadar is new alluvium deposited by floods.
2. Bhabar is a marshy lowland lying south of the Tarai.
3. Bhangar is old alluvium on higher ground beyond normal flood reach.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nindian-geography-19-2.x: Bhabar is the pebbly foothill belt where streams sink; the marshy Tarai lies south of it.

nindian-geography-19-10.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Khadar – Marshy lowland south of Bhabar
Bhangar – New alluvium deposited by floods
Bhabar – Coarse alluvial belt where streams disappear
Tarai – Old alluvium with calcareous concretions
nindian-geography-19-10.x: Bhabar is the coarse belt where streams disappear. Khadar is new flood alluvium, Bhangar old alluvium with kankar and Tarai the marshy land south of Bhabar.
